events.help: Manually force the model family, bypassing autodetection. The engine normally detects the family from jang_config.json / config.json; pass this to override that when detection is wrong (e.g. renamed fine-tunes, GGUF, custom merges). The chosen family's cache + tool/reasoning parser contract is used. 'auto' (or omitting the flag) keeps autodetection. Run with an unknown family name and the engine still honors it with a kv cache + a warning. Example: --model-family qwen3

events.help: Opt out of the generic default-on paged cache. Paged cache is ON by default for autodetected TEXT models at startup EXCEPT arch-incompatible families (M3, openPangu-v2, gemma4 mixed-SWA) and MLLM/VL loads (pending the #98 byte-ceiling). This flag disables that generic default; families whose native cache REQUIRES paged (DSV4 composite, Zaya CCA, hybrid SSM) still enable it via their own policy.

--awq-alpha.help: AWQ scaling factor (0.0-1.0). Only used when --use-awq is enabled. Higher values increase activation awareness. Default: 0.25.

--default-top-k.help: Server-wide default top-k for generation. Overridden by per-request 'top_k'. If not set, uses generation_config.json / jang_config metadata when present.

--is-mllm.help: Force the model to load as a multimodal (vision) model even if auto-detection doesn't recognize it. Use this for VLM models that aren't in the built-in registry. Auto-detection checks config.json for 'vision_config'.

--jang-method.help: JANG quantization method: mse (MSE for attention, RTN for MLP), rtn (fast), mse-all (MSE everywhere, slow). Default: mse

--jang-profile.help: JANG adaptive profile (e.g. JANG_2S, JANG_3M, JANG_4L). Automatically assigns different bit widths to attention vs MLP tensors.

--kv-cache-group-size.help: Group size for KV cache quantization (default: 64)

--kv-cache-quantization.help: Storage-boundary KV quantization used by cache-on rows. auto omits the CLI flag so the engine chooses per architecture; use q4/q8 for explicit lossy storage-codec stress rows.

--log-level.help: Server log verbosity. DEBUG shows all details, ERROR shows only errors. (default: INFO)

--long-probes.help: Use longer image/video/no-media prompts so MTP verify cycles are exercised.

--lora-paths.help: Optional local LoRA adapter path(s) for image models. Accepts space-separated values or a comma-separated list.

--lora-scales.help: Optional LoRA scale(s) matching --lora-paths order. Accepts space-separated values or a comma-separated list.

--mcp-config.help: Path to MCP (Model Context Protocol) config file (JSON/YAML). Enables the model to call external tools (web search, code execution, etc.) via MCP servers. Tools appear in /v1/mcp/tools and can be used in chat completions with tool_choice.

--mcp-disabled-servers.help: Comma-separated MCP server deny-list for this model session.

--mcp-disabled-tools.help: Comma-separated MCP tool deny-list for this model session.

--mcp-enabled-servers.help: Comma-separated MCP server allow-list for this model session.

--mcp-enabled-tools.help: Comma-separated MCP tool allow-list for this model session.

--media-prefix-cache.help: Enable experimental media-keyed MLLM prefix cache for this gate.

--memory-total-budget-percent.help: Total memory budget as fraction of RAM (default: 0.85)

--mflux-class.help: Explicit mflux model class name (e.g., Flux1, Flux2Klein, ZImage, QwenImageEdit). Used by the image loader to pick the correct Python class. If not set, falls back to name-based lookup.

--mllm.help: Force MLLM benchmark mode (auto-detected by default)

--model-family.help: Manually force the model family, bypassing autodetection. The engine normally detects the family from jang_config.json / config.json; pass this to override that when detection is wrong (e.g. renamed fine-tunes, GGUF, custom merges). The chosen family's cache + tool/reasoning parser contract is used. 'auto' (or omitting the flag) keeps autodetection. Run with an unknown family name and the engine still honors it with a kv cache + a warning. Example: --model-family qwen3

--mtp-cost-ar-step-ms.help: Override AR ms/token calibration used by --mtp-cost-fallback.

--mtp-cost-fallback.help: Research flag: enable measured MTP->AR fallback using traced MTP cost and an AR-step calibration from the baseline row.

--mtp-cost-ratio-threshold.help: Disable MTP for the request when measured MTP cost ratio reaches this value.

--native-mtp-depth.help: Depth for native in-model MTP heads on preserved-MTP bundles. D3 is the current Qwen3.6 default; overridden by VMLX_NATIVE_MTP_DEPTH.

--native-mtp-sampling-policy.help: Native MTP request policy. compatible-only leaves sampling defaults alone and uses MTP only for deterministic requests. deterministic-defaults is used by the app for native-MTP sessions to set deterministic temperature/top-p/top-k/min-p without applying repetition-penalty guards.

--no-advertise.help: Disable Bonjour/mDNS advertisement (use manual IP on coordinator)

--no-continuous-batching.help: Use the direct single-request engine and disable cache-stack features that require continuous batching.

--no-memory-aware-cache.help: Disable memory-aware cache, use legacy entry-count based cache

--no-mtp-burst.help: Disable verified-token burst draining while benchmarking MTP.

--no-paged-cache.help: Disable the generic in-memory paged-cache tier. Block Disk Cache may remain enabled as an SSD-only tier on supported architectures. Architecture-owned native caches may still use internal block transport; inspect startup output and /health for the effective policy.

--no-state-machine-stops.help: Disable token-level reasoning/stop detection via SequenceStateMachine (Phase 3c) and fall back to the legacy substring '<think>' scan. Useful for rollback if a regression appears. (default: state machine ON)

--num-draft-tokens.help: Number of tokens the draft model proposes per speculative decoding step. Higher values = more potential speedup but lower acceptance rate. Typical sweet spot is 2-5. (default: 3)

--omni-backend.help: Nemotron-Omni multimodal backend. stage1 is correctness-first PyTorch/MPS; stage2 opts into the native MLX RADIO + Parakeet path via VMLX_OMNI_BACKEND=stage2.

--pld-summary-interval.help: Log a PLD effectiveness summary every N spec-decode tokens. The summary reports accept rate, full/zero %%, and eff tok/pass (>1.0 = net gain over baseline). (default: 487)

--policy-sweep-save-all.help: Include all real-logit policy rows, not just top summaries.

--policy-sweep-top-n.help: If >0, rank stochastic p/q sampler policies on real D1..Dk logits.

--prefill-keep-alloc.help: Skip per-prefill-chunk mx.clear_cache() calls by setting VMLX_PREFILL_KEEP_ALLOC=1. This is opt-in for long text-only chunked prefill tuning; default behavior is unchanged.

--prefill-step-size.help: Tokens per prefill chunk — reduce for large MoE models hitting Metal OOM (default: 2048)

--prefix-cache-max-bytes.help: Optional global byte budget for the prefix cache. When set, eviction fires when total cached bytes exceed this. Eviction priority is assistant → user → system, so shared system prompts persist across users/sessions. None = unlimited (entry-count only). (default: None)

--prefix-cache-size.help: Max entries in prefix cache (default: 100, legacy mode only)

--prompt.default: Count from one to eight, comma-separated. Return only the numbers.

--prompts.help: Number of prompts to benchmark for LLM (default: 5)

--rate-limit.help: Maximum requests per minute per client IP. Prevents abuse from a single client overwhelming the server. 0 = no limit. Example: --rate-limit 60

--raw-prompt.help: Use the prompt text directly instead of the chat template.

--repeat-media-cache.help: Send identical and changed media payloads to probe media cache hit/miss behavior.

--run-owned-check.help: Execute one release check as a child owned by this preflight

--secret.help: Cluster secret for authentication (must match coordinator). Prefer setting VMLX_CLUSTER_SECRET env var instead so the secret doesn't appear in `ps aux` process listings.

--served-model-name.help: Custom model name exposed via /v1/models API. Clients use this name in requests. Useful for aliasing long model paths. Default: auto-extracted from model path.

--server-url.help: URL of the vmlx-engine server (default: http://localhost:8000)

--skip-release-manifest.help: Skip release manifest enforcement for dry/no-app integrity checks

--smelt.help: Enable Smelt mode for benchmarking with partial expert loading.

--smelt-experts.help: Percentage of experts to load per MoE layer (default: 50)

--speculative-model.help: Path or HuggingFace name of a small draft model for speculative decoding. The draft model proposes tokens that the main model verifies in a single forward pass, giving 20-90%% speedup with zero quality loss. Must use the same tokenizer as the main model. Example: --speculative-model mlx-community/Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct-4bit

--ssm-state-cache-mb.help: Approximate memory budget in MB for hybrid SSM companion states (default: 512)

--ssm-state-cache-size.help: Maximum in-memory SSM companion entries for hybrid models (default: 8)

--stream-interval.help: How many tokens to generate before sending a streaming update to the client. 1 = send every token (smoothest typing effect). Higher values batch tokens for slightly better throughput. Requires --continuous-batching. (default: 1)

--text-only.help: Force the model to load as TEXT-ONLY even if auto-detection recognizes it as a vision/multimodal model. Overrides --is-mllm and autodetect. Backs the UI 'Force Off' multimodal toggle for genuinely-detected VL models.

--thinking.help: Per-request thinking mode for live API checks

--tool-call-parser.help: Which format to use for parsing tool calls from model output. Must match your model's training format. Common choices: 'qwen' for Qwen models, 'llama' for Llama 3+, 'hermes' for Hermes/NousResearch, 'mistral' for Mistral. Use 'auto' to detect from model name. Requires --enable-auto-tool-choice.

--turboquant-critical-layers.help: Critical layers for higher precision (comma-separated, e.g., '0,1,2,-1')

--turboquant-sink-tokens.help: Number of sink tokens to keep at full precision (default: 4)

--uds.help: Path to a Unix domain socket to bind instead of host/port. When set, --host and --port are ignored. Example: --uds /tmp/vmlx.sock

--use-awq.help: Enable AWQ (Activation-Aware Weighting) scaling for better quality. Experimental. Adds activation norm collection step before quantization.

--use-paged-cache.help: Use paged KV cache in Apple unified memory (experimental). NOTE: bench does not apply the serve-path generic paged default-on; pass this explicitly to benchmark the paged backend.

--video.help: Run video benchmark instead of image benchmark (for MLLM models)

--video-path.help: Local path to video file for benchmark

--video-url.help: URL of video to use for benchmark (default: Big Buck Bunny 10s)

--wake-timeout.help: Maximum time in seconds to wait for a model to reload from deep sleep during a JIT wake. Larger models may need higher values to finish loading. (default: 300)

--worker-nodes.help: Comma-separated list of worker node addresses (ip:port). Use instead of Bonjour auto-discovery. Example: 192.168.1.10:9100,192.168.1.11:9100

convert.help: Convert HuggingFace model to quantized MLX or JANG format

doctor.help: Run diagnostics on a model directory
